name: Flunitrazepam
summary: Flunitrazepam (Rohypnol) is a very strong benzodiazepine sleep medicine that is heavily regulated and not approved in the US.
description: Flunitrazepam is a very strong (high-potency) benzodiazepine. It causes sleep and sedation, eases anxiety and relaxes muscles. It stays in your body a long time, which helps people fall asleep and stay asleep. Because it can cause memory loss and has a history of misuse, including as a 'date rape' drug, Rohypnol is heavily regulated and not approved for use in the United States. Some countries still prescribe it for severe insomnia that has not responded to other treatment, or to calm people before anesthesia.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Flunitrazepam is a high-potency benzodiazepine with strong hypnotic, sedative, anxiolytic, and muscle relaxant properties. It has a long elimination half-life, making it effective for sleep induction and maintenance. Due to its amnesic effects and history of misuse, including as a 'date rape' drug, Rohypnol is heavily regulated and not approved for use in the United States. It is still prescribed in some countries for severe, refractory insomnia or as a pre-anesthetic medication.
